extDescription.message: Ad-free, local-only prompt library for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok. No account, no tracking.

cmdToggle.message: Open the prompt panel on the current page

emptyList.message: No prompts found. Add some under Manage.

copiedFallback.message: No prompt box found here — copied to clipboard instead. Paste with Ctrl/Cmd+V.

insertFailed.message: Could not insert or copy. Open the prompt and copy it manually.

templateHelp.message: Use {{name}} for a variable, {{tone|friendly}} for a variable with a default. You fill them in when inserting.

confirmDelete.message: Delete "$1"? This cannot be undone (export first if unsure).

confirmDeleteFolder.message: Delete folder "$1"? Its prompts are kept and moved to "No folder".

folderLimit.message: The free plan includes $1 folders. (Pro is not available yet.)

exportHelp.message: Downloads all prompts and folders as a JSON file. Keep it somewhere safe — it is your backup.

modeMerge.message: Merge (keep everything; conflicting prompts are added as copies)

modeReplace.message: Replace (an automatic backup is made first)

confirmReplace.message: Replace all current prompts with the file? A backup will be created first.

importDone.message: Imported: $1 added, $2 identical skipped, $3 conflicts added as copies.

backupMade.message: A backup of the previous data was saved (see Backups).

backupsHelp.message: Automatic backups are taken before replace, restore and data migrations. The last 10 are kept in this browser.

confirmRestore.message: Restore this backup? Your current data is backed up first.

settingFloating.message: Show the floating button on supported sites

shortcutHelp.message: Shortcut: Alt+Shift+P opens the panel (change it at chrome://extensions/shortcuts).

privacyText.message: Your prompts stay in this browser unless you turn on Sync: then they are stored in your own Chrome sync storage (your Google account), which Chrome syncs itself. The extension makes no network requests, has no analytics and no ads. The only planned exception is an optional Pro license check with Lemon Squeezy, which is switched off in this version.

licenseDisabled.message: Pro licensing is not active yet (placeholder). All features are unlocked for free.

licenseEnabled.message: Enter your license key to activate Pro.

backupReminder.message: It has been a while since your last export. Export your prompts to keep a copy outside the browser.

packsHelp.message: Ready-made templates, written for this extension. Installing copies them into your library as normal prompts; your own prompts are never overwritten. Uninstalling removes only the pack prompts you did not edit.

syncHelp.message: Uses your own Chrome sync (the Google account you are signed in to Chrome with). No server of ours is involved. This browser's local data always stays the source of truth.

syncEnable.message: Sync my prompts with Chrome sync

adapterChrome.message: Chrome sync (default, up to ~90 KB compressed)

adapterDrive.message: Google Drive app folder (not available yet)

syncReset.message: Replace cloud copy with this device

conflictsHelp.message: When the same prompt was changed differently on two devices, both versions are kept. Pick one, or keep both.

syncWhyTitle.message: Why Chrome sync and not Google Drive?

cmpChromeAccount.message: None from us; uses the user's Chrome sign-in

cmpDriveAccount.message: We need a Google Cloud project + OAuth client

cmpChromeSize.message: 100 KB total, 8 KB per item, 512 items

historyPolicyHelp.message: History is stored only in this browser. The newest version of each prompt is always kept.

packInstalled.message: Pack installed: $1 prompts added, $2 already present (left unchanged).

packUninstalled.message: Pack removed: $1 unedited prompts deleted, $2 edited prompts kept in your library.

syncStatus_ok_near_quota.message: In sync — close to the Chrome sync size limit

syncStatus_waiting_remote.message: Waiting for another device's upload to finish arriving

syncStatus_backoff.message: Chrome sync is busy — retrying later

syncStatus_over_quota.message: Too large for Chrome sync — not uploading. Your local prompts are safe. Remove or shorten prompts, or export a backup.

syncStatus_remote_corrupt.message: The cloud copy cannot be read. Nothing was changed locally. You can replace the cloud copy with this device.

syncStatus_unavailable.message: This storage option is not available yet

syncStatus_disabled.message: Sync is off. Prompts stay only in this browser.

syncStats.message: Last run: $1 added, $2 updated, $3 deleted, $4 conflicts

confirmSyncReset.message: Replace the cloud copy with this device's prompts? The current cloud copy is saved as a local backup first.

conflictBanner.message: $1 sync conflict(s) need your decision. Both versions are kept until you choose.

noHistory.message: No earlier versions yet. A version is saved every time you change this prompt.
